newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Delivery sees poor Q4 results.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Delivery sees poor Q4 results.

text.p: Consolidated Delivery & Logistics Inc's newly appointed chairman and chief executive said the company is about to report "disappointing fourth-quarter results which may produce an operating loss for the year."
"It is clear we must move quickly to re-engineer and consolidate our business," Albert Van Ness said in a press statement. Van Ness did not provide specific details.
Later, the company's chief financial officer, Joseph Wojack, told Reuters, "The magnitude of the loss (for the quarter and year) is not known yet."
Wojack said the losses stem from a combination of start-up expenses on new projects and continuing losses at the company's Distribution Solutions unit. The company sold the unit in January, he added.
He also said the company would take a one-time charge for the fourth-quarter, although he did not specify its size.
He said the company would release its financial statements for the quarter and year on February 27.
